annotation.title_clean: Action plan for the digital transformation of Slovakia for 2019 – 2022
annotation.title_en: Action plan for the digital transformation of Slovakia for 2019 – 2022
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Office of the Plenipotentiary of the Government of the Slovak Republic for Investments and Informatization (ODPMII), Government of the Slovak Republic
annotation.venue: Government of the Slovak Republic / ODPMII
annotation.summary_en: Slovakia's 2019–2022 action plan implementing its 2030 Digital Transformation Strategy, with measures on education, data economy, smart mobility including self-driving vehicle testing legislation, public administration and AI. AI measures cover a regulatory analysis, ethics principles, an ethics and regulation committee, and liability and insurance rules. Embodied AI content is limited to autonomous vehicles.
key_provisions_or_claims: Set up a permanent committee for ethics and regulation of AI (by March 2020).
Analyse the AI regulatory environment and design principles of transparent and ethical AI use, including legal liability and insurance frameworks.
Prepare legislation for testing and operation of self-driving vehicles, with a one-stop shop and licensing.
Regulatory sandboxes and dynamic regulation to support innovation.
Align AI use with OECD AI Principles and EU Ethics Guidelines for Trustworthy AI.
